items.author: battech.bsky.social
items.context: I've never felt good about buying a 70$ game. Every single time I felt like I got fucked. 60$? Plenty of purchases I'm happy with but not a single 70$ game felt done let alone worth it.
items.text: Fair take. Waiting a few months for reviews, patches and a sale means you pay less for a more finished game.

items.author: bendo2levi.bsky.social
items.context:
Saw Dying Light was on sale on Steam for $5 with a bunch of dlc included I didn't like the game on ps4, felt stiff, but couldn't pass it up and I think I'll have more fun with M&K controls for both the free running and the crafting interface. looking forward to giving this another shot!
link card: Superstore: Amy Sosa on Second Chances
items.text: Mouse and keyboard should make the parkour feel a lot smoother. And at that price, Steam's refund window (14 days, under 2 hours played) is a nice safety net if it still doesn't click.
